main.bio: I am a Full Stack Developer with over 4 years of experience designing and building scalable enterprise web applications using C#, .NET Core, React, Node.js, TypeScript, SQL Server, and cloud technologies. Currently, I work at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), contributing to enterprise application development. Previously, I developed AI-powered governance platforms at VerifyWise and enterprise software solutions at Encubate Tech for international clients. I enjoy solving complex problems, building high-quality software, and continuously learning modern technologies.

testimonials.text: I worked closely with Swaleha. She’s a very reliable and thoughtful developer. She’s strong in Javascript, React, TypeScript, and Node.js. She doesn’t just code and really thinks about how things should work. She asks great questions, cares about quality, and takes ownership when something needs fixing. She communicates clearly, supports her teammates, and can be trusted with important parts of a product. I’d happily work with her again and strongly recommend her to any team.

I’m thrilled to recommend Swaleha. She consistently delivers scalable, secure, and high-performing web applications, seamlessly integrating front-end and back-end functionality. Her technical expertise, problem-solving skills, and meticulous attention to detail make her an invaluable and trusted team member.

Swaleha has been a cornerstone of innovation at FlexC, playing a pivotal role in the development of the OCTO feature. Her dedication to quality, problem-solving mindset, and technical expertise have consistently exceeded expectations.
testimonials.user: Prasoon Kumar Gupta, CTO at FlexC
